text:
Zara Osei: Hi everyone! I'm Zara — joining product infra as a platform engineer. First day 🎉 Quick Qs: who should I ping for MDM/SSH access? My laptop is asking for a PIN but I haven't seen an MDM invite yet. Thanks!

Jamie Park: Welcome Zara!! :tada: You're in great hands. I'll DM you a buddy. @Samir will be your onboarding buddy. For MDM/device help ping @Lina (IT). Also join #dev-oncall and #platform-standup.

Samir Chen: hey Zara — hi! I'll grab a slot for a 1:1 in calendar. If you want we can pair on your first PR later today. Wifi creds are in the onboarding doc. :coffee:

Lina (IT): Hi Zara — Lina from IT here. Sorry about the invite delay. Can you check if you got an email from "Okta Device Management" (sometimes lands in promotions)? If not, reply here and I'll re-send. Once MDM installs, run the following to verify:
```bash
# enroll (mac)
sudo profiles install -type enrollment -path /tmp/okta.mobileconfig
# verify
profiles status -type enrollment
```

Zara Osei: Thanks @Lina (IT)! I don't see the email in spam. I'm on a company MacBook Air (serial ABC123).

Lina (IT): Got it — re-sent invite to zara.osei@redwood.ai. Check spam and promotions. If nothing in 5m I'll create a manual token and push you into the team group so Slack + Google get provisioned.

devops-bot: New hire provisioning: user zara.osei created. Resources added: github (team: platform-engineering), slack (channels: #new-hires, #platform), gcp (project: dev-platform).

Kevin (Security): Hi Zara — welcome. Quick reminder to enroll in MFA and hardware 2FA if you're remote. If you want a YubiKey, reply to ops-ticket #9876 and we'll ship one.

Jamie Park: Team note — Zara will be on-call rotation starting in ~3 weeks. Samir will pair-train her on the paging runbook this week. @Zara Osei don't forget to claim your welcome sticker pack from People Ops.

Alyssa (Design): welcome!! also where are you located? we have a local lunch group. :)

Zara Osei: I'm in Toronto (EST). Lunch group sounds great. Small fun fact: I make sourdough.

Samir Chen: sourdough club. count me in. :bread: 

Lina (IT): Email delivered. Let me know when you enroll.

Zara Osei: just enrolled — MDM shows "Compliant". SSH access still failing with `Permission denied (publickey)`. I pushed my SSH pubkey to the onboarding repo but maybe wrong path.

Jamie Park: put the public key at https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-keys under your handle. If already there, @ops-bot can run a quick sync.

ops-bot: SSH key sync triggered for zara.osei. ETA ~2m.

ops-bot: SSH key sync complete — keys installed on dev jump hosts. Try again.

Zara Osei: Success! SSH works now. Thanks everyone. Last quick Q: where's the first-week checklist doc?

Jamie Park: Nice. Checklist is at https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/first-week (internal). TL;DR: 1) Enroll MDM 2) Request 2FA/YubiKey 3) Add SSH key 4) Join teams/channels 5) Shadow on-call 6) PR setup. I'll drop a 1hr onboarding sync at 4pm on your calendar.

Lina (IT): FYI I've added camera permission to your MDM profile for Zoom. You should be good to go.

Zara Osei: All set. Thanks y'all. Excited to be here! :sparkles:
